description: A chorus and a tremolo running side by side on one input, mixed half and half at the output, after the maker's Water guitar pedal

params.text: Sets how much of the chorus is mixed in against the dry signal
Sets the speed of both effects at once, the chorus sines and the tremolo triangle running from the one knob
Sets how deeply the tremolo triangle shapes the level
Nothing in the module reads this trimmer; the chorus depth jack is scaled by the chorus depth knob itself, so it changes nothing
Attenuates the rate jack before it is added to the rate of both effects
Attenuates the tremolo depth jack before it is added to the depth knob

inputs.text: Raises and lowers the chorus depth, a volt moving it by half the setting of the depth knob itself
Raises and lowers the speed of both effects, exponentially, scaled by the trimmer beside it
Raises and lowers the tremolo depth, scaled by the trimmer beside it
The signal both effects work on

outputs.text: The chorus and the tremolo mixed in equal parts

notes: this is mono: one channel in, one channel out, whatever a polyphonic cable carries
the two lamps at the top follow the chorus sine and the tremolo triangle, so the rate can be read off the panel
